item.title: Protect Your Consciousness from AI
item.description:
📝 On social media, people are using LLMs to generate posts just for impressions, instead of going through the process of finding sources and creating authentic content themselves. I want to bring back authentic forum posts, where people can share their ideas and thoughts, with less algorithmic influence than platforms like X. LLMs can be prompted into agreeing with you, which is less likely than with a licensed therapist - it's important to have human to human feedback.
🔗 Read more: https://jordangoodman.bearblog.dev/protect-your-consciousness-from-ai/

item.title: The Sega Master System
item.description:
📝 The only real candidate for this is an SG-1000 in different packaging that came out along the way. The Famicom doubled that to 2KB, and the Master System jumped it up to 8. The only addition on this side is that its palette information is stored in an independent “Color RAM” that only holds 32 bytes.
🔗 Read more: https://bumbershootsoft.wordpress.com/2025/11/08/the-sega-master-system/

item.title: Drilling Down on Uncle Sam's Proposed TP-Link Ban
item.description:
📝 TP-Link Systems told The Post it has sole ownership of some engineering, design and manufacturing capabilities in China that were once part of China-based TP-Link Technologies, and that it operates them without Chinese government supervision. That price point (and consistently excellent performance ratings) has made TP-Link a favorite among Internet service providers (ISPs) that provide routers to their customers. TP-Link rightly points out that most of its competitors likewise source components from China.
🔗 Read more: https://krebsonsecurity.com/2025/11/drilling-down-on-uncle-sams-proposed-tp-link-ban/

item.title: American Heart Association says melatonin may be linked to serious heart risks
item.description:
📝 Date: November 4, 2025 Source: American Heart Association Summary: Long-term melatonin use for sleep problems may come with unexpected heart dangers. 5 times more likely to be hospitalized for heart failure. Long-Term Melatonin Use Linked to Higher Heart Failure Risk People who regularly take melatonin to improve sleep may face serious health risks.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2025/11/251104012959.htm
